question: Which of the following instruments is played by Shreya Bhattacharjee, an eminent musician from Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tabla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Shreya Bhattacharjee is a renowned musician from Assam known for her expertise in playing the **Tabla**.
 
• She started her journey in music at a young age and has achieved remarkable recognition in the field of Indian classical music.
 
• Shreya has won numerous awards and accolades for her exceptional Tabla performances at national and international levels.
 
• She has contributed significantly to promoting Indian classical percussion instruments, especially among the younger generation.
 
• Her mastery over intricate rhythms and patterns makes her a celebrated artist in the world of classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tabla:**

 
 
• The Tabla is a pair of twin hand-played drums used in Indian classical music and other genres.
 
• It comprises two drums – the **Dayan** (right drum, smaller, wooden) and the **Bayan** (left drum, larger, metal or clay).
 
• The instrument is known for its ability to produce intricate rhythms and tonal variations.
 
 
 
• **Indian Classical Music:**
 
 
• Indian classical music has two major traditions – Hindustani (North Indian) and Carnatic (South Indian).
 
• The Tabla is a prominent percussion instrument in Hindustani classical music.
 
 
 
• **Famous Tabla Players:**
 
 
• Legendary artists like Ustad Zakir Hussain and Pandit Kishan Maharaj have popularized the Tabla globally.
 
 
 
• **Rhythm in Music:**
 
 
• In Indian classical music, rhythms are structured into cycles called **Tala**, which serve as the foundation for compositions and improvisation.
